name: Cisco Firepower — IPS Event with Critical Severity (v2)
alert_name: Cisco Firepower — IPS Event with Critical Severity (v2)
description: Snort/FTD intrusion event at CEF severity >= 9. Replaces rule 72, which filtered cefName = "Intrusion Detected" - a value neither Cisco nor this tenant produces. FTD CEF carries the eStreamer eNcore name "INTRUSION EVENT". Direction corrected: src is the external attacker, dst the internal victim.
xql_query:
dataset = cisco_firepower_raw
| filter cefName = "INTRUSION EVENT" and to_integer(cefSeverity) >= 9
| alter attacker_ip = src, attacker_port = spt, victim_ip = dst, victim_port = dpt
| alter signature = cs2, ips_policy = cs5, ips_rule_id = cs6, threat_category = cat
